text.tspan: I used to handle this badly. I double-checked
an order and caught a near miss.
What changed is simpler than it sounds. Family
updates were clearer when we used plain
language.
Support staff make care possible. Treat them
that way.
Protocols protect patients and clinicians.

saved minutes we needed.
